body:
The first disposable VM controls are complete against sealed Dolphin candidate b2868df82ed3199e628721ad6fb3f1fb95a3a04a. All 104 helper cases, six actual launcher-guard controls and 13 native-error mapping controls pass. Eight original preparation controls reproduce lost/replaced synthetic files: original fragments exit 0; their preservation assertion remains expected failure 1. These are component controls with injected mounts, not native engine or full-launcher proof. No owner data was used.

Can the next proof be done on the VM? Yes. The coordinator has prepared a separate bounded private mount/network namespace to execute the exact helper with actual mountinfo and rename APIs: clean GC, Wii/GC switching, six synthetic raw-card writes through links, retained real-state refusal, nested mount, read-only mount and unavailable mount. Inputs are newly created synthetic files on a 128 MiB tmpfs. This remains helper/file-I/O proof; it does not establish Dolphin engine compatibility or automatic states. The existing admitted VM owns this serialized experiment; no physical action, provider, game or account is involved.

Exact original results are retained under /workspace/tmp/pix-m7-library-vm-20261013/dolphin-results pending durable compact packet integration. The existing source lane is checking clean defaults and localized error copy separately; these results remain bound to b2868.
